lines: This Jvālinī in fire-wheel; by her and hundred-and-eight hundred should recite if; then would succeed three worlds with moving and nonmoving.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣā jvālinyagnicakre tayā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam japedyadi tataḥ siddhyettrailokyaṃ sacarācaram
